articles.title: Neanderthals may have used prehistoric glue as an ancient antibiotic
articles.summary: Neanderthals may have used a sticky substance made from birch bark to treat wounds thousands of years before antibiotics existed. Previously known mainly as a prehistoric glue, birch tar may have doubled as a surprisingly effective natural medicine.
